output.reason: The constraint_extraction stage is not atomic: the candidate design graph must be audited across separable chip-design layers before it can serve as SACG shared state. Independent specialists can review model/shape semantics, numeric/template binding, memory/runtime/tool evidence, and human/verification boundaries in parallel, followed by a graph integrity auditor that gates promotion using checker evidence. No missing checker capability is apparent because the required static and evidence checks are present in the action grounding registry.

handoff_rule.on_failure: emit bounded constraint gap report identifying missing or inconsistent model/shape SACG nodes; block downstream template binding until corrected.
handoff_rule.on_pass: handoff model and shape review findings to constraint_extraction.constraint_graph_auditor for graph promotion decision.

subtasks.objective: Audit that decoder semantics, operator order, residual paths, attention/head facts, hidden dimensions, sequence assumptions, and shape relationships from the model configuration are explicitly represented in the initial design graph and linked to cross-layer constraints.
subtasks.title: Review model semantics and shape constraints

handoff_rule.on_failure: block promotion of the design graph until numeric/template ambiguity is represented as SACG constraints or bounded repair requests; do not permit free-form RTL assumptions.
handoff_rule.on_pass: handoff numeric policy, template coverage, and parameter binding evidence to constraint_extraction.constraint_graph_auditor.

subtasks.objective: Verify that numeric policy, quantization assumptions, trusted template library coverage, design-space parameters, and resource-risk assumptions are captured as template-constrained SACG facts rather than implicit implementation choices.
subtasks.role: numeric policy and template binding engineer
subtasks.title: Review numeric policy and template constraints

handoff_rule.on_failure: block later code generation or backend claims where board/runtime/tool facts lack evidence; create bounded graph repair items for missing DDR, AXI, runtime ABI, or tool protocol constraints.
handoff_rule.on_pass: handoff board DDR/AXI/runtime/tool evidence mapping and stream-memory findings to constraint_extraction.constraint_graph_auditor.

subtasks.objective: Audit that stream order, transfer/liveness assumptions, DDR and AXI address mapping, board runtime ABI, deployment target, tool profile, tool availability, and tool protocols are represented in the initial design graph with cited evidence.
subtasks.title: Review data, memory, runtime, and tool constraints

handoff_rule.on_failure: block graph promotion if human approval boundaries, case adapter expectations, or repair limits are absent or inconsistent; require bounded SACG repair before downstream stages.
handoff_rule.on_pass: handoff task, case-adapter, verification, human-boundary, and repair-boundary findings to constraint_extraction.constraint_graph_auditor.

subtasks.objective: Check that the task goal, verification case adapter, human-agent boundary, approval requirements, and repair boundaries are explicit in the graph so later failures can be localized to violated SACG constraints.
subtasks.title: Review verification, case adapter, and human boundaries

handoff_rule.on_failure: return bounded graph repair requests to the failing parallel-group-0 specialist areas and prevent consumption of the candidate graph as trusted shared state.
handoff_rule.on_pass: promote the audited initial design graph as SACG shared state for subsequent architecture/template planning stages.

subtasks.objective: Integrate specialist reviews and decide whether the initial design graph is a checker-supported, cross-layer-consistent SACG state suitable for downstream chip-design-team stages, or whether bounded graph repairs are required.
subtasks.title: Gate audited design graph promotion
